reader.summary: During this window, Taiwan's economic and technological news dominated. TSMC confirmed exploration of a $4 billion Texas complex for AI chip production in partnership with Nvidia, while the government moved to curb AI chip exports to China as part of a broader US trade deal, signaling tighter alignment with Washington on semiconductor policy. In energy diplomacy, Taiwan signaled readiness to invest $4.4 billion in an Alaska LNG pipeline project promoted by President Trump, who in turn said Taiwan would purchase 30 percent of the output. On the domestic front, the president urged Micron workers and management to negotiate sincerely ahead of a possible strike at the fabrication plant, a labor dispute now in its second reporting window. Financial markets saw a Taiwan stock boom that prompted some fund managers to quit and trade their own capital, though the dollar slumped alongside the won as a chip-stock selloff dented sentiment. Taiwan also blocked the crypto and prediction platforms Coinbase and Kalshi over suspected election-related betting. Smaller stories included PharmaEssentia's global drug-approval expansion, Delta's AI-era power-grid unveiling, and a presidential advisory urging citizens to skip Chinese revolutionary-anniversary events.

crystal.summary: Next week, Taiwan's semiconductor policy will move from headline announcement to on-the-ground implementation. The government will publish specific rules restricting AI chip exports to mainland China, and Chinese firms will respond with alternative sourcing plans or tariff threats. At the Micron fabrication plant in Taoyuan, workers and management will either sign a new labor agreement or call a formal strike vote, with the president watching the outcome closely. On the energy front, Taiwan's ministry will lock in contract terms for its 30 percent share of Alaskan LNG while the pipeline faces congressional scrutiny in Washington. The stock market boom will cool as the dollar and won struggle against chip-sector jitters, and fund managers who quit to trade their own capital will face their first full week of self-directed portfolios. The Coinbase and Kalshi blocks will largely fade from view unless a legal challenge emerges.

display.headline: Chip Curbs Tighten, Micron Strike Looms as LNG Deal Takes Shape
emoji_reasons: Semiconductors and AI chip policy dominate every major story this window, from the Texas investment to the China export curbs.
The Micron labor dispute enters its second reporting window with a strike vote or new deal imminent.
The Alaska LNG pipeline commitment and the 30 percent purchase pledge make fuel and gas logistics a central diplomatic topic.
display.tldr: Taiwan will implement AI chip export bans on China and finalize its Alaska LNG purchase terms. The Micron labor dispute will reach a resolution, either a signed deal or a strike. Markets will wobble as chip stocks cool.
display.eli5:
This week in Taiwan, the biggest news was all about computer chips. TSMC is building a new factory in Texas, and the government agreed to limit which AI chips it sells to China as part of a deal with the US. Think of it like a store deciding which items to sell to a rival shop across the street.

At the same time, workers at the Micron chip plant in Taoyuan are in a pay dispute with their bosses. The president has asked both sides to negotiate sincerely, but if they do not agree, the workers may walk out and shut down a production line. Next week we will find out whether a deal gets signed or a strike gets called.

Taiwan also said it will buy a third of the gas from a big pipeline project in Alaska that President Trump keeps pushing. That deal needs paperwork and congressional approval, so we expect more news on the contract details. The Coinbase and Kalshi app blocks will probably quiet down unless someone takes the government to court.

A surprise would be China reacting strongly to the chip export limits, maybe by restricting its own rare-earth exports or holding a big naval drill near Taiwan. That would turn a trade story into a military one overnight.
